articles.title: Bank Of Japan Raises Rate To 1.25%; Highest Since 1995
articles.expand: The Bank of Japan raised its benchmark rate by a quarter point to a 31-year high amid high inflation and weaker yen. The policy board, governed by Ueda Kazu, decided by a 7-2 majority vote to raise the interest rate to 1.25 percent, marking the highest since 1995. The move was widely anticipated by markets.
